Updates.NoRelease.zh: 还没有可用的发布版本

Updates.InstallFailed.zh: 更新未完成，已保留或恢复原版本。
Updates.InstallFailed.en: Update did not complete. The previous version was retained or restored.

Updates.PreviousInstallFailed.zh: 上次更新到 v{0} 未完成，请查看错误详情。
Updates.PreviousInstallFailed.en: The previous update to v{0} did not complete. See the details below.

Updates.ExitSaveFailed.zh: 无法保存当前画布，已取消更新。
Updates.ExitSaveFailed.en: Unable to save the current canvas. The update was cancelled.

Updates.NoNotes.zh: 这个版本没有提供更新说明。

Updates.NotesCurrent.zh: 当前版本 v{0} 的更新内容
Updates.NotesCurrent.en: What's new in the current version, v{0}

Updates.NotesRange.zh: v{0} → v{1} · {2} 个版本的更新内容

Updates.NotesIncomplete.zh: 部分历史日志未能加载，以下内容可能不完整。可重新检查或查看完整日志；已找到的更新包仍可安装。
Updates.NotesIncomplete.en: Some release history could not be loaded. This list may be incomplete. Check again or view the full changelog; the available package can still be installed.

Updates.NotesDisplayLimited.zh: 日志过长，窗口仅展示部分条目。请点击“查看更多日志”阅读完整内容。
Updates.NotesDisplayLimited.en: This history is too long to display in full. Use View full changelog to read the remaining entries.

Updates.NotesUnavailable.zh: 以下版本未提供可识别的当前语言日志：{0}。不影响更新安装。
Updates.NotesUnavailable.en: Recognized notes in your language are unavailable for: {0}. This does not prevent installation.

Updates.CheckIncomplete.zh: 检查未完成，请重试或手动查看发布版本
Updates.CheckIncomplete.en: Check incomplete. Retry or browse releases manually

Updates.ManualRequired.zh: 有新版本，请手动下载安装包
Updates.ManualRequired.en: A newer version is available. Download it manually

Updates.OpenManualQuestion.zh: 是否打开官方发布页，手动下载安装包？保存作品并退出浮绘后运行 Setup.exe，或将 ZIP 完整解压到新目录；保留个人资料和工程文件。
Updates.OpenManualQuestion.en: Open the official release page to download manually? Save your work and exit FloatCanvas, then run Setup.exe or extract the entire ZIP into a new folder. Keep your profile and project files.

Updates.ManualHint.zh: 点击“手动下载安装包”打开官方发布页。保存作品并退出浮绘后，运行 Setup.exe 安装包；便携版可将 ZIP 完整解压到新目录。保留个人资料和工程文件。
Updates.ManualHint.en: Open the official release page with Download manually. Save your work and exit FloatCanvas, then run Setup.exe; for a portable copy, extract the entire ZIP into a new folder. Keep your profile and project files.

Updates.Cancelled.zh: 已取消，当前版本可以继续使用
Updates.Cancelled.en: Cancelled. You can keep using the current version.

Updates.Restarting.zh: 正在安装，完成后将自动重启…

Updates.Development.zh: 无法安装更新。请确认程序文件完整，且当前账户可写入程序目录。修复后可重新检查。
Updates.Development.en: The update cannot be installed. Check that the package is complete and the application folder is writable, then check again.

Updates.InstallBlockedDetails.zh:
无法安装更新：{0}
修复后请重新检查，或将完整发行包解压到新目录。
Updates.InstallBlockedDetails.en:
The update cannot be installed: {0}
Fix the issue and check again, or extract the complete release into a new folder.

Updates.IncompletePackage.en: A package file is missing or empty: {0}

Updates.DirectoryAccessDenied.zh: 当前账户无权访问或写入程序目录。
Updates.DirectoryAccessDenied.en: Your Windows account cannot access or write to the application folder.

Updates.RequiresSetup.zh: 所有用户安装需要通过安装向导更新。
Updates.RequiresSetup.en: All-users installations must be updated through Setup.

Updates.OpenLinkFailed.zh: 无法打开 GitHub 链接
